title: Resource
description: A single Terraform resource block, as parsed from target_infra .tf files. Not persisted as its own JSON file on Day 1 — this schema documents the shape terraform_parser_tools.py must produce from main.tf / main.patched.tf.

resource_name.description: Terraform local resource label (the second string in the resource block header)

attributes.description: Raw key/value attributes as parsed by python-hcl2 (bucket, role, member, name, etc.)

source_file.description: Relative path of the .tf file this resource was parsed from
